---
title: "Benchmark Report: SV Genotyping in the HPRC Pangenome (-x 15 vs -x 0)"
output: html_document
params:
  benchmark_dir:
    value: "benchmarks"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

# Load packages
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(knitr)

# Helper function
sec_to_h <- function(x) x / 3600

# Benchmark directory from params
benchmark_dir <- params$benchmark_dir
```

## Objective

This report compares the runtime and memory usage of the **pangenie** SV genotyping pipeline with two different `-x` options:

* `-x 15` (higher parallelism)
* `-x 0` (single-threaded/default)

We analyze three pipeline steps:

1. **Indexing**
2. **Calling**
3. **Genotyping**

## Data Loading and Preprocessing

```{r load-benchmarks}
# List benchmark files
benchmark_files <- list.files(
  benchmark_dir,
  full.names = TRUE,
  pattern = "_benchmark_x[0-9]+\\.txt$"
)

# Read and process all files
bench_list <- lapply(benchmark_files, function(f) {
  df <- read_tsv(f, col_types = cols())
  
  # Convert CPU time to hours
  df$time_h <- sec_to_h(df$cpu_time)
  
  # Extract graph_name, step, replicate from filename
  fname <- basename(f)
  m <- str_match(
    fname,
    "^(.*)_pangenie_(index|calling|genotyping)_benchmark_(x[0-9]+)\\.txt$"
  )
  
  df$graph_name <- m[,2]
  df$step <- m[,3]
  df$replicate <- m[,4]
  
  df
})

# Combine into one dataframe
bench_df <- bind_rows(bench_list)

# Aggregate replicates
bench_summary <- bench_df %>%
  group_by(graph_name, step, replicate) %>%
  summarise(
    time_h = mean(time_h, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_rss = mean(max_rss, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Factor ordering
bench_summary$step <- factor(bench_summary$step, levels = c("index", "calling", "genotyping"))
bench_summary$graph_name <- factor(bench_summary$graph_name, levels = unique(bench_summary$graph_name))
```

## Benchmark Plots

### Runtime per Step

```{r plot-runtime, echo=FALSE}
p_time <- ggplot(bench_summary, aes(x = step, y = time_h, fill = replicate)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  facet_wrap(~graph_name, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    y = "Time (Hours)",
    x = "Pipeline Step",
    title = "Pangenie Benchmark: Runtime per Step and Graph",
    fill = "X option"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

print(p_time)
```

### Memory Usage per Step

```{r plot-memory, echo=FALSE}
p_mem <- ggplot(bench_summary, aes(x = step, y = max_rss, fill = replicate)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  facet_wrap(~graph_name, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    y = "Max RSS (MB)",
    x = "Pipeline Step",
    title = "Pangenie Benchmark: Memory Usage per Step",
    fill = "X option"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

print(p_mem)
```
